listing.name: Killzone: Liberation — KillzoneLiberation-Recomp (Tzeentchnet)
listing.summary: Upstream reports completing Chapter 1, the tutorial and Mission 1. Saving and full-game testing continue; ad hoc networking is absent. Portcove has not confirmed runtime behavior or gameplay. Follow the setup instructions below. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own exact supported USA UCUS98646 Killzone: Liberation v1.20 ISO. Keep your original separately.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow the source-only instructions to extract and translate your own ISO. Build kzl.exe with Visual Studio, clang-cl, the required SDK and CMake, then keep the same ISO available while playing. Portcove does not install or prepare this source project automatically.
